aliases: Plasma ELISA titers to SARS-CoV-2 spike RBD
SARS-CoV-2 spike protein receptor binding domain (RBD) ELISA
SARS-CoV-2 RBD ELISA.readouts: anti-spike RBD IgG, IgM, and IgA titers

evidence_location.quote: All patients were confirmed COVID-19 cases by SARS-CoV-2 RBD ELISA ( Figures 1 and S1 ). All cases were IgG positive; anti-RBD IgM and IgA was also detected in the large majority of cases

Direct ex vivo PBMC immune cell phenotyp.name_in_paper: Direct ex vivo PBMC immune cell phenotyping
Direct ex vivo PBMC immune cell phenotyp.readouts: frequencies of CD3+ total T cells, CD4+ T cells, CD8+ T cells, CD19+ B cells, CD3-CD19- cells, and CD14+CD16- monocytes

evidence_location.quote: The frequency of CD3 + cells was slightly increased in recovered COVID-19 patients relative to non-exposed controls, while no significant differences overall were observed in the frequencies of CD4 + or CD8 + T cells between the two groups. Frequencies of CD19 + cells were somewhat decreased

aliases: T cell receptor (TCR) dependent activation induced marker (AIM) assays
Activation induced cell marker assay.readouts: frequency of SARS-CoV-2-specific AIM+ CD4+ T cells (OX40+ CD137+) and AIM+ CD8+ T cells (CD69+ CD137+) after peptide stimulation; antigen specificity/immunodominance

evidence_location.quote: SARS-CoV-2 spike-specific CD4 + T cell responses (OX40 + CD137 + ) were detected in 100% of COVID-19 cases

Cytokine bead assays.readouts: secreted cytokine levels including IL-2, IFN-γ, IL-4, IL-5, IL-13, and IL-17α after peptide stimulation

evidence_location.quote: To assess functionality and polarization of the SARS-CoV-2-specific CD4 + T cell response, we measured cytokines secreted in response to MP stimulation. The SARS-CoV-2-specific CD4 + T cells were functional, as the cells produced IL-2 in response to non-spike and spike MPs

Intracellular cytokine staining assay.readouts: percentage of CD8+ T cells producing IFN-γ and co-expressing granzyme B, TNF-α, or IL-10 after peptide stimulation

evidence_location.quote: Independently, ICS assays detected IFN-γ + SARS-CoV-2-specific CD8 + T cells in the majority of COVID-19 cases
